title: real_process_startup_code_evicts_and_reaps_the_worker fails on macOS: next call gets control_cleanup_pending after the test reaped the worker
outcome: The cause of the macOS failure is classified from code and evidence as product or fixture. Either the evict-and-reap path confirms control cleanup before the next request, so a later call starts a new worker, or the test waits for the documented cleanup confirmation. No timeout increase, no retry, and no weakening of the assertion.
acceptance: The macOS failure of real_process_startup_code_evicts_and_reaps_the_worker (control_cleanup_pending at engram_control_startup_codes.rs:180) is classified from code and evidence as product or fixture.

Either the evict-and-reap path confirms control cleanup before the next request, so a later call starts a new worker, or the test waits for the documented cleanup confirmation. There is no timeout increase, no retry and no weakening of the assertion. The test passes on macOS in a launcher run on the fixed tree and still passes on Windows.
